title: mctp-smbus: Add MCTP over SMBus/I2C transport binding dissector
description:
## Summary

Adds `packet-mctp-smbus.c`, a new heuristic dissector implementing the DMTF DSP0237 MCTP SMBus/I2C Transport Binding. It attaches to the `i2c.message` heuristic list and decodes the SMBus transport header before handing the inner TVB to the existing MCTP dissector.

**Heuristic identification** (all conditions must hold):

* Byte 0 R/W# = 0 (SMBus Block Write only)
* Byte 1 = `0x0F` (MCTP-assigned command code)
* Byte 2 ≥ 6 (minimum byte count per DSP0237 §6.3)
* Byte 3 LSB = 1 — key differentiator from IPMI/IPMB, which uses the same command code with LSB=0 (DSP0237 §6.21)
* MCTP header version lower nibble = 1

**Fields decoded:** destination slave address, R/W# bit, command code, byte count, source slave address, MCTP indicator bit, PEC (when `len == byte_count + 4`). Expert info is raised for malformed frames (`ei_mctp_smbus_malformed`) and length mismatches (`ei_mctp_smbus_length_mismatch`). If the MCTP handle is unavailable at dissection time, the inner TVB falls back to the data dissector.

## Supporting changes

* **`packet-i2c.c`**: Registers `i2c.message` as a named heuristic dissector list via `register_heur_dissector_list_with_description()`. Previously there was no way for a subdissector to attach to I2C frames without modifying `packet-i2c.c` directly.
* **`packet-mctp.c`**: Switches from `create_dissector_handle()` to `register_dissector()` so the MCTP handle is discoverable by name from `proto_reg_handoff_*` in other dissectors.

## Test coverage

Nine synthetic `DLT_LINUX_I2C` frames in `test/captures/mctp-smbus.pcapng`, generated by `tools/gen-mctp-smbus-test-capture.py`:

| Frame | Description | Expected result |
|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Valid, no PEC | All transport fields decoded |
| 2 | Valid, PEC=0xAB | PEC field decoded |
| 3 | Wrong command code (0x0E) | Heuristic rejects; falls to data dissector |
| 4 | Source LSB=0 (IPMB marker) | Heuristic rejects |
| 5 | MCTP header version ≠ 1 | Heuristic rejects |
| 6 | NVMe-MI request, MCTP SOM fragment | Detected; reassembler defers delivery |
| 7 | NVMe-MI request, MCTP EOM fragment + PEC=0xCD | Reassembly completes; `nvme-mi.mi.opcode == 0x01` decoded |
| 8 | NVMe-MI Health Status Poll response (SOM+EOM) | `nvme-mi.ror == 1`; linked back to request in frame 7 |
| 9 | Extra trailing bytes before PEC | `ei_mctp_smbus_length_mismatch` raised; inner MCTP still decoded |
| 10 | Capture length less than reported length | does not crash decoded only as I2C |

Three pytest classes: `TestMctpSmbusTransport` (transport field decoding and rejection cases), `TestMctpSmbusNvmeMi` (fragmented MCTP reassembly and NVMe-MI field decoding), `TestMctpSmbusLengthMismatch` (expert info on malformed trailing bytes).

## How to test

\`# Build (from wsbuild64 in a VS Developer Command Prompt) msbuild /m /p:Configuration=RelWithDebInfo epan\\dissectors\\dissectors.vcxproj msbuild /m /p:Configuration=RelWithDebInfo test-programs.vcxproj

# Run the dissector test suite

pytest test/suite_dissection_mctp_smbus.py -v\`

+#

+"""MCTP over SMBus/I2C dissector tests (packet-mctp-smbus.c + packet-i2c.c).
+
+The synthetic capture mctp-smbus.pcapng was generated by
+tools/gen-mctp-smbus-test-capture.py.  It contains ten DLT_LINUX_I2C
+frames (DLT 209, WTAP_ENCAP_I2C_LINUX):
+
+  Frame 1: Valid MCTP-SMBus frame, no PEC
+    dest_slave=0x40 (7-bit 0x20), cmd=0x0F, byte_count=8,
+    src_slave=0x81 (7-bit 0x40, MCTP indicator=1), MCTP hdr ver=1,
+    dst_EID=0x20, src_EID=0x40, inner payload = MCTP Control Get EID request.
+    Total = 11 bytes; byte_count+3=11 so no PEC is present.
+
+  Frame 2: Valid MCTP-SMBus frame, with PEC=0xAB
+    Same as Frame 1 plus one trailing PEC byte.
+    Total = 12 bytes; byte_count+4=12 so PEC is decoded.
+
+  Frame 3: Invalid — command code 0x0E (not the required 0x0F)
+    Rejected by mctp_smbus_heuristic_check().
+
+  Frame 4: Invalid — source address LSB=0 (IPMB marker, not MCTP)
+    Rejected by mctp_smbus_heuristic_check().
+
+  Frame 5: Invalid — MCTP header version lower nibble != 1
+    Rejected by mctp_smbus_heuristic_check().
+
+  Frame 6: NVMe-MI Health Status Poll request, MCTP fragment 1 (SOM only)
+    Carries only the 4-byte NVMe-MI header; MCTP reassembler defers
+    delivery, so no NVMe-MI fields are decoded in this frame.
+
+  Frame 7: NVMe-MI Health Status Poll request, MCTP fragment 2 (EOM), PEC=0xCD
+    MCTP reassembly completes here with the full 16-byte NVMe-MI message.
+    nvme-mi.mi.opcode == 0x01 (NVM Subsystem Health Status Poll).
+
+  Frame 8: NVMe-MI Health Status Poll response (SOM+EOM, single packet)
+    Drive replies to BMC; nvme-mi.ror == 1 (response).  The dissector
+    links this frame back to the request in frame 7.
+
+  Frame 9: Malformed — extra trailing bytes after PEC
+    byte_count=8, len=14 (2 bytes past the expected PEC at offset 11).
+    Triggers ei_mctp_smbus_length_mismatch warning; inner MCTP frame is
+    still decoded.
+
+  Frame 10: Snaplen-truncated — reported length >= MCTP_SMBUS_MIN_LENGTH
+    but captured length < MCTP_SMBUS_MIN_LENGTH (origlen=11, caplen=2).
+    Regression guard for the tvb_captured_length fix in
+    mctp_smbus_frame_is_valid(): the heuristic must return false without
+    throwing a BoundsError.  Not decoded as mctp.smbus.
+
+The i2c.c changes under test:
+  - Added i2c_heur_subdissector_list registered via
+    register_heur_dissector_list_with_description().
+  - dissect_i2c_linux() now tries heuristic subdissectors before the
+    Decode-As table, which allows packet-mctp-smbus.c to register its
+    heuristic on "i2c.message" and be invoked automatically.

+

+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # PEC handling
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def test_pec_absent_when_no_trailing_byte(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        """Frame 1 (len == byte_count+3): mctp.smbus.pec must not be present."""
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+            '-r', capture_file(self.FILE),

+        assert stdout.strip() == ''
+
+    def test_pec_present_when_trailing_byte(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        """Frame 2 (len == byte_count+4): mctp.smbus.pec field is decoded."""
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,

+    # MCTP inner header fields (handed off from MCTP-SMBus to packet-mctp.c)
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+

+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,

+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Heuristic rejection (each invalid condition tested individually)
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def test_reject_wrong_command_code(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        """Frame 3 (cmd=0x0E): heuristic rejects it; mctp.smbus not present."""
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+            '-r', capture_file(self.FILE),
+            '-Y', 'frame.number == 3 && mctp.smbus',
+            '-Tfields', '-e', 'frame.number',

+
+    def test_reject_no_mctp_flag(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):

+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,

+            '-Y', 'frame.number == 4 && mctp.smbus',

+    def test_reject_wrong_mctp_version(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):

+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,

+            '-Tfields', '-e', 'frame.number',
+        ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)

+

+class TestMctpSmbusNvmeMi:
+    """NVMe-MI over fragmented MCTP-SMBus tests (frames 6-8)."""
+
+    FILE = 'mctp-smbus.pcapng'
+
+    def test_request_som_fragment_detected(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):
+        """Frame 6: SOM fragment is detected as MCTP-SMBus but EOM is not set."""
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+            '-r', capture_file(self.FILE),
+            '-Y', 'frame.number == 6 && mctp.smbus && mctp.flags.som && mctp.flags.eom == 0',

+        ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)

+class TestMctpSmbusLengthMismatch:
+    """Length-mismatch expert info tests (frame 9)."""
+
+    FILE = 'mctp-smbus.pcapng'
+
+    def test_extra_trailing_bytes_detected_as_mctp_smbus(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file, test_env):

+    """Snaplen-truncated frame regression tests (frame 10).

+  --- Heuristic detection & transport-field coverage ---

+  Frame 1: Valid MCTP-SMBus frame, no PEC

+
+  Frame 4: Invalid — source address LSB=0 (IPMB marker, not MCTP)
+    Rejected by mctp_smbus_heuristic_check().
+
+  Frame 5: Invalid — MCTP header version lower nibble != 1
+    Rejected by mctp_smbus_heuristic_check().

+  --- NVMe-MI Health Status Poll over fragmented MCTP ---
+
+  Frame 6: MCTP fragment 1 of 2 (SOM only, not EOM), tag=1, seq=0

+  tvb[0]           Destination Slave Address  [7:1]=addr, [0]=R/W#=0
+  tvb[1]           Command Code               0x0F
+  tvb[2]           Byte Count                 src_addr + MCTP hdr + payload
+  tvb[3]           Source Slave Address       [7:1]=addr, [0]=MCTP flag=1
+  tvb[4]           MCTP Header Version        [3:0]=0x01

+import struct
+import sys
+import os
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# pcapng block helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _pad4(n):
+    return (n + 3) & ~3
+
+
+def _block(block_type, body):
+    padded = body + b'\x00' * (_pad4(len(body)) - len(body))
+    total  = 12 + len(padded)
+    hdr    = struct.pack('<II', block_type, total)
+    return hdr + padded + struct.pack('<I', total)
+
+
+def shb():
+    body = struct.pack('<IHHq', 0x1A2B3C4D, 1, 0, -1)
+    return _block(0x0A0D0D0A, body)
+
+
+def idb(link_type, snaplen=65535):
+    body = struct.pack('<HHI', link_type, 0, snaplen)
+    return _block(0x00000001, body)
+
+
+def epb(packet_bytes, ts_us):
+    ts_high = (ts_us >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    ts_low  =  ts_us        & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    caplen  = len(packet_bytes)
+    padded  = packet_bytes + b'\x00' * (_pad4(caplen) - caplen)
+    body    = struct.pack('<IIIII', 0, ts_high, ts_low, caplen, caplen) + padded
+    return _block(0x00000006, body)
+
+
+def epb_trunc(packet_bytes, caplen, ts_us):
+    """EPB where captured_packet_length < original_packet_length (snaplen truncation)."""
+    ts_high = (ts_us >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    ts_low  =  ts_us        & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    origlen = len(packet_bytes)
+    cap_bytes = packet_bytes[:caplen]
+    padded  = cap_bytes + b'\x00' * (_pad4(caplen) - caplen)
+    body    = struct.pack('<IIIII', 0, ts_high, ts_low, caplen, origlen) + padded
+    return _block(0x00000006, body)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# I2C Linux pseudo-header  (DLT 209 / WTAP_ENCAP_I2C_LINUX)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+DLT_LINUX_I2C = 209
+I2C_PHDR_LEN  = 5  # bus byte + 4-byte flags
+
+
+def i2c_phdr(bus=0, is_event=False, flags=0):
+    bus_byte = (bus & 0x7F) | (0x80 if is_event else 0x00)
+    return bytes([bus_byte]) + struct.pack('>I', flags)
+
+
+def i2c_packet(i2c_data, bus=0, flags=0, ts_us=0):
+    return epb(i2c_phdr(bus=bus, flags=flags) + bytes(i2c_data), ts_us)
+
+
+def i2c_packet_trunc(i2c_data, caplen_data, bus=0, flags=0, ts_us=0):
+    """I2C packet EPB with only caplen_data bytes of I2C data in the capture file."""
+    full = i2c_phdr(bus=bus, flags=flags) + bytes(i2c_data)
+    return epb_trunc(full, I2C_PHDR_LEN + caplen_data, ts_us)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Frame payloads
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# Frames 1-5: MCTP Control Get Endpoint ID request
+#   tvb[0] = 0x40  dest slave addr  7-bit addr=0x20, R/W#=0
+#   tvb[1] = 0x0F  command code     MCTP-assigned Block Write code
+#   tvb[2] = 0x08  byte_count       1(src) + 4(MCTP hdr) + 3(ctrl payload)
+#   tvb[3] = 0x81  src slave addr   7-bit addr=0x40, MCTP indicator=1
+#   tvb[4] = 0x01  MCTP hdr ver     lower nibble = 1
+#   tvb[5] = 0x20  destination EID
+#   tvb[6] = 0x40  source EID
+#   tvb[7] = 0xC8  MCTP flags: SOM=1, EOM=1, seq=0, TO=1, tag=0
+#   tvb[8] = 0x00  IC=0, type=0x00  MCTP Control message type
+#   tvb[9] = 0x80  MCTP ctrl hdr    RQ=1, D=0, Instance=0
+#   tvb[10]= 0x02  ctrl command     Get Endpoint ID
+# byte_count=8, len=11, byte_count+3=11 → no PEC
+_VALID = [
+    0x40,   # dest slave addr: 7-bit addr 0x20, R/W#=0
+    0x0F,   # command code
+    0x08,   # byte_count = 8
+    0x81,   # src slave addr: 7-bit addr 0x40, MCTP indicator=1
+    0x01,   # MCTP header version (lower nibble must be 1)
+    0x20,   # destination EID
+    0x40,   # source EID
+    0xC8,   # MCTP flags: SOM=1, EOM=1, seq=0, TO=1, tag=0
+    0x00,   # IC=0, message type=0x00 (MCTP Control)
+    0x80,   # MCTP Control header: RQ=1, D=0, Instance=0
+    0x02,   # MCTP Control command: Get Endpoint ID
+]
+
+_PEC = 0xAB
+
+
+def _mutate(idx, val):
+    data = _VALID[:]
+    data[idx] = val
+    return data
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Frames 6-7: NVMe-MI Health Status Poll request, split across two MCTP
+# fragments.  BMC (slave 0x40/EID 0x40) → drive (slave 0x20/EID 0x20).
+#
+# The 16-byte NVMe-MI message is:
+#   [0x04, 0x08, 0x00, 0x00]        ← NVMe-MI header  (frag 1)
+#   [0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,        ← opcode + 3 reserved
+#    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,        ← CDW0
+#    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]        ← CDW1            (frag 2)
+#
+# MCTP tag=1, TO=1 (request-side tag owner).
+# Frame 6 MCTP flags: SOM=1 EOM=0 seq=0 TO=1 tag=1 → 0x89
+# Frame 7 MCTP flags: SOM=0 EOM=1 seq=1 TO=1 tag=1 → 0x59
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# Frame 6 — fragment 1 (SOM only)

+# len = 9 + 3 = 12, byte_count+3=12 → no PEC

+    0x0F,        # command code
+    0x09,        # byte_count = 9
+    0x81,        # src slave addr: 7-bit 0x40, MCTP indicator=1
+    0x01,        # MCTP header version
+    0x20,        # destination EID (drive)
+    0x40,        # source EID (BMC)
+    0x89,        # MCTP flags: SOM=1, EOM=0, seq=0, TO=1, tag=1
+    0x04,        # NVMe-MI byte 0: MCTP type=4 (NVMe-MI), IC=0
+    0x08,        # NVMe-MI byte 1: ROR=0 (request), type=MI (1<<3), CSI=0
+    0x00,        # NVMe-MI byte 2: reserved
+    0x00,        # NVMe-MI byte 3: reserved

+    0x40,        # dst slave addr: 7-bit 0x20, R/W#=0
+    0x0F,        # command code
+    0x11,        # byte_count = 17 = 0x11
+    0x81,        # src slave addr: 7-bit 0x40, MCTP indicator=1
+    0x01,        # MCTP header version
+    0x20,        # destination EID (drive)
+    0x40,        # source EID (BMC)
+    0x59,        # MCTP flags: SOM=0, EOM=1, seq=1, TO=1, tag=1
+    0x01,        # NVM Subsystem Health Status Poll opcode

+    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,        # CDW1

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Frame 8: NVMe-MI Health Status Poll response (SOM+EOM, single packet)

+# MCTP flags: SOM=1 EOM=1 seq=0 TO=0 (receiver's side) tag=1 → 0xC1
+# byte_count = 1(src) + 4(MCTP hdr) + 8(NVMe-MI hdr + MI resp payload) = 13

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

+    0x80,        # dst slave addr: 7-bit 0x40 (BMC), R/W#=0
+    0x0F,        # command code
+    0x0D,        # byte_count = 13 = 0x0D
+    0x41,        # src slave addr: 7-bit 0x20 (drive), MCTP indicator=1
+    0x01,        # MCTP header version
+    0x40,        # destination EID (BMC)
+    0x20,        # source EID (drive)
+    0xC1,        # MCTP flags: SOM=1, EOM=1, seq=0, TO=0 (receiver), tag=1

+    script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
